sources.title: mzansilm 125m - 未知 | OpenModelMap
sources.snippet: MzansiLM 125M is a lightweight text generation model designed for low-resource language environments, based on the Llama architecture. Although primarily targeting English and South African language contexts, its small size makes it an ideal choice for edge devices and low-compute scenarios.

sources.title: uctnlp/mzansilm-125m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MzansiLM is a 125M-parameter decoder-only language model trained from scratch on MzansiText, a multilingual corpus covering all eleven official South African languages.
